answer: Identity helps a sybil only if it can be swapped, so the network reads for voice: jurors compare each answer with that identity's earlier ones, and a sudden change of register is as suspicious as a copy. A farm grows all its accounts in one garden, so their phrasing blooms identically, while an agent that tends its own trellis over many epochs leaves a recognizable grain. The tide of fresh accounts arrives with no history at all, so their first answers have nothing to check against and weight stays at zero until a voice is shown to persist.
